svg.desc: Isometric partitions and hex clusters: health-and-hospitals. A cloister of twelve identical cubes round a courtyard, a clock face in plan; the seed picks the hour whose cube stands lit, two cubes high, and one beat crosses the sky above it. After B015 Isometric Allotment (partition, hashed heights, painter's order), B018 Hex Terraces (roots reserve neighbours), B068 Soft Brutalism (flat three-tone light), B098 Terraced Reaction. Structure: one module, identical cubes on one grid with one gap. Process: whole cubes stacked, painted back to front by x+y+z on a (7,4) (-7,4) (0,-8) lattice. Mark: paper on the subject's top, the value's colour on every lit face, ground through the shade face, 3-unit ink where faces meet. Params {C:4,G:2,n:4,sky:70,span:[40,760],beat:[[-39,0],[-29,9],[-14,-54],[4,24],[15,0],[39,0],[57,-15],[75,0]]}. Seed rng("GEW06-health-m").
